entity: City of Elgin, Illinois public water system (IL0894380), lead 90th-percentile tap results over the 15 ppb action level; plus count of 10K+ systems over the lead line on newest test

sources.quote: The 90th percentile value of the samples reached 43 parts per billion.
sources.searcher_note: Elgin Jan-Jun 2025 round: 48 of 100 high-risk homes over 15 ppb, 90th percentile 43 ppb; attributes rise to new fifth-liter sampling; also mentions Aurora.

sources.quote: In the first testing cycle of the year, the system's 90th-percentile lead reading was 0.0185 milligrams per liter, compared with the federal action level of 0.015.
sources.searcher_note: Post-cutoff. Elgin over the lead action level again in first-half 2026 at 18.5 ppb; says it improved from the prior period after treatment changes. Rewrite of a Daily Herald story.

sources.quote: The first set of results from this year indicates a 90th percentile value of 0.0185 mg/L, which exceeds the lead action level of 0.015 mg/L.
sources.searcher_note: City's own July 2026 notice; also says this period is much lower than previous periods, crediting orthophosphate added November 2025. Page gives no exact day.

sources.quote: In January 2022, Illinois EPA issued a Lead ALE to the City based on its 90th percentile lead level of 22.5 ppb for the July – December 2021 monitoring period.
sources.searcher_note: Earliest found: state regulator records Elgin exceedances at 22.5 ppb (Jul-Dec 2021) and 21 ppb (Jul-Dec 2022); supports Elgin being over before the 2025 testing change.

sources.outlet: Protect Kids From Lead (report: 91 Lead exceedences in five years)
sources.quote: Elgin PWS, serving the City of Elgin located in Kane County, has experienced five exceedances.
sources.searcher_note: 2025 NGO report: 91 lead exceedances at 72 Illinois systems, Jan 2020 to May 13 2025; Elgin ranked among three with repeated exceedances; its table lists an Elgin reading of 50 on October 18, 2024. PDF text; page has no exact date.

sources.quote: During the first half of 2023, eight homes had lead in the water at such level. In the most recent round of testing, 19 did.
sources.searcher_note: Elgin second-half 2023 round: 19 of 100 homes over the action level (Kane County Reporter gives 22.9 ppb 90th percentile for the same round).

notes: Many sources name Elgin exceeding the 15 ppb lead action level repeatedly (2021, 2022, 2023, 2025, 2026). No source found states 53 ppb; the highest found are 43 ppb (FOX 32, Jan-Jun 2025) and a 50 in the PKFL table (Oct 2024). A search for 53 ppb only hit an unrelated EWG monochloroacetic-acid guideline. Daily Herald stories (2025-01-16 'Elgin officials say new testing protocols cause more homes to test positive for elevated lead levels'; 2025-07-15 'Elgin again alerting residents of elevated lead levels in drinking water') returned empty pages to fetch (bot wall), so not recorded as sources. Axios Chicago 2026-01-30 ('Chicago tests just 0.01% of homes for lead in water', search snippet says Elgin found high lead in 70% of homes tested) returned 403. No source found for the 'about 17 systems serving 10K+ over the line' count. 7 queries run.
